raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Risk and Control Professional with over 11 years of experience across financial services operations, specialized in control testing, RCSA, and risk governance. Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end risk assessment, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance (CASS, REMS). Proven ability to lead and mentor high-performing teams within control environments, driving excellence in stakeholder management and audit remediation. Skilled at conducting comprehensive risk reviews, executing large-scale control validations and continuously enhancing frameworks to deliver effective risk mitigation and compliance assurance for global operations.
raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Northern Trust Corporation, Bengaluru
Sept 2014 – Feb 2026
Consultant, Officer Enterprise Risk Management - BU Control Testing
Conducted RCSA control testing and process design reviews to evaluate control effectiveness, identify gaps, and recommend improvements, leveraging deep expertise in Risk and Control Self-Assessment to strengthen risk mitigation and ensure regulatory compliance across complex business processes. Lead process design reviews to streamline workflows, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure robust control frameworks across multiple business functions.

Performed EUC risk assessments to identify and mitigate risks associated with End User Computing tools, implementing remediation strategies to safeguard data integrity.
Proactively assess emerging risks, design action plans, and mitigate control weaknesses to ensure business resilience.
Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, identifying and addressing control gaps,


and driving continuous improvement in operational efficiency. Strong experience in stakeholder management, collaborating with cross-functional teams and senior leaders to implement solutions that mitigate risks and align with business objectives. Skilled in optimizing business operations, enhancing workflows, and ensuring compliance with industry regulations.
Demonstrated
leadership
in managing cross-functional
teams, delivering process

improvements and executing large-scale initiatives to drive business outcomes. Lead loss event data collection, validation and non-financial risk analysis initiatives across business lines and geographies.
Performed control testing across Custody and Securities Services processes, specifically covering CASS and REMS controls, assessing control effectiveness, identifying gaps, and supporting remediation activities across 1LOD and 2LOD environments.
Monitored regulatory requirements and changes impacting Custody/Securities Services, reviewed CASS and REMS requirements, assessed control effectiveness and gaps, and supported the implementation and enhancement of compliance frameworks, SOPs and controls.
Conducted root cause analysis on operational failures and loss events, developed mitigation strategies and control recommendations.
• Performed risk assessment, quality control, audit procedures and prepared monthly reports
to assess KPI and KRI compliance by identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing operational risks and effectiveness of control designed to mitigate key risk areas.
Maintained integrity of the operational risk loss event repository by accurately capturing losses and recoveries above USD 5,000, while reviewing and validating Actual Single Loss (ASL) incident notifications exceeding USD 250,000 to ensure adherence to regulator prescribed timelines and content requirements.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams and engaged with senior stakeholders, operations to implement control improvements.
Technical Coordinator/Emerging Lead Global Reconciliation – Custody operations (Centre of Excellence)
Managed paydown asset investigations and provide resolution in accordance with CASS and REMS guidelines.
Handled complex issue escalations, manage migration efforts, and prepare monthly control reports for senior stakeholders.
Prepared migration and testing plans during procedural and technological upgrades. • Served as the primary point of contact for factored securities and Unit trust Income, reconciliations, worked closely with Investment Managers and clients to resolve discrepancies.
Conducted TLM and balance reconciliation of client holdings against external sources (Bloomberg, DTC, FED) and identified discrepancies, driving resolution efforts in collaboration with stakeholders. Identified market-level trade corrections and corporate action events, implemented solutions to maintain accuracy and compliance.

Resolved Client issues and complex queries with solutions-oriented approach, aiming to maintain and improve client trust.
Developed and maintained Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), conducted quality checks, and ensured compliance with relevant regulations and audit requirements.
Trained new hires and maintained strict adherence to control processes to ensure quality and accuracy in all operations.

SPOC for Service Now application for migration of all Loss event data events from Archer.
